title: Stream transcript (invalid): SESSION_INIT with reserved flag bits set
description: Serialized SAR stream transcript with a SESSION_INIT entry whose flags field has reserved bits set (bits 4..15). Reserved SESSION_INIT flag bits must be zero per spec. Must be rejected with SAR_ERR_RESERVED_VALUE.
notes: This is a serialized SAR stream transcript, not an ordinary static archive.
SESSION_FLAGS bits 4..15 are reserved and must be zero.
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
